premium.basis: premium to the unaffected closing price on January 25, 2024, as identified by MorphoSys

value_inflection_events.event: Phase 3 MANIFEST-2 study of pelabresib met primary endpoint (spleen volume reduction) but showed mixed symptom data, leading to a sharp sell-off.
Presentation of full Phase 3 MANIFEST-2 data at ASH showing improvement in all four hallmarks of myelofibrosis, driving a significant recovery.
Novartis announced a definitive agreement to acquire MorphoSys for €68.00 per share in cash.

leaked_early.details: The deal was reported by Reuters on the morning of the official announcement date, February 5, 2024, not one month prior.

notes: The deal was driven by Novartis's interest in the Phase 3 BET inhibitor pelabresib. A rival bidder, Incyte, was reported to be involved in the process on the day of the announcement, but Novartis secured the deal.
